title: Pre-hospital analgesia in paediatric trauma patients - a retrospective analysis of pain levels, pain documentation and adherence to guidelines among patients of a supra regional trauma centre
summary: Children and adolescents with accident-related injuries often suffer from severe pain before admission to hospital. This pain should be treated by the ambulance service as early as possible. This study investigates how the treatment of pain of injured children and adolescents is actually conducted before they arrive at hospital. To this end, existing treatment data of 346 Patients who were admitted to a supraregional trauma centre following an accident between 2020 und 2025 are beeing analysed. Factors examined include the pain-relieving medicines used, their dosages, pain documentation and level of pain on admission to hospital. The findings are intenend to help further improve the pre-hospital pain management.

interventions.name: This is a retrospective data analysis. The analysis focuses on patients aged between 0 and 15 years, who were admitted betweeen November 2020 and November 2025 to a supraregional trauma center by ambulance (RTW) or air ambulance (RTH),  both as primary transport directly from the scenenof the accide
